english.title: Issuing body fail to ensure that all IDs and pre-printed blank stock are securely managed on its premises
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an issuing body, failed to ensure that all equine IDs and pre-printed blank stock were securely managed on its premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)
